parchment-canvas.$description: Parchment Canvas — Page background and disabled input surfaces — the barely-warm off-white that reads as paper, not screen

pure-surface.$description: Pure Surface — Card backgrounds, nav surface, input fills, elevated overlays

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary heading and body text — near-black with the faintest warm undertone that keeps it from feeling harsh

deep-charcoal.$description: Deep Charcoal — Nav text, footer text, secondary headings, filled icon fills; Decorative gradient on AI-enhanced copy indicators — transitions from dark charcoal through amber, pink, lavender, sky, chartreuse, then fades transparent

carbon.$description: Carbon — Medium-emphasis link and body text, supporting secondary labels

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary nav labels, metadata, muted helper text, secondary icon fills

graphite.$description: Graphite — List secondary text, overlay-context captions

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Hairline dividers, card borders, rule lines across all UI contexts — the dominant structural border color

stone-border.$description: Stone Border — Button borders on white-fill controls, card-level contained borders

fog-surface.$description: Fog Surface — Soft hover state fills, subtle input surface overlays

olive-press.$description: Olive Press — Large decorative accent surfaces in product UI mockups — the vivid chartreuse that signals AI-enhanced state

forest-cta.$description: Forest CTA — Primary download/action button fill — deep olive-green that feels botanical and grounded against white, not techy

fern-border.$description: Fern Border — Accent borders, focus-adjacent decorative strokes, icon tints in the green family

sprout-tint.$description: Sprout Tint — Secondary pill button backgrounds (announcement badge, iPhone download) — the lightest olive wash

twitter-blue.$description: Twitter Blue — Social proof badge icons, X/Twitter brand color used in testimonial cards

link-cobalt.$description: Link Cobalt — Inline text links within body copy and social testimonial cards

ember-fill.$description: Ember Fill — Orange wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

ember-border.$description: Ember Border — Orange outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

melange.$description: All UI text: navigation, body copy, buttons, labels, card content, footer. Its 0.01em tracking at 13-16px sizes keeps small text from collapsing — the slightly wider-than-normal tracking is the fingerprint of this face at body sizes. Weight 300 appears for light supporting text, 600 for active nav states and strong labels.

quadrant.$description: All display headings and hero text. The sole serif in the system — its old-style proportions at 68px with -0.015em tracking give headlines editorial gravity that sans-serif alternatives cannot replicate. At smaller sizes (16-24px) it serves section subheadings with the same print warmth. Weight 400 throughout — heavier weights would destroy the handwritten-note quality.

apple-system-system-ui.$description: Fallback and embedded-content contexts (social card content, badge text, Twitter embed surfaces). Not a deliberate brand choice — follows OS defaults in embedded third-party content zones.

system-ui.$description: system-ui — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
